articles.title: Jim Cramer explains why even strong bank earnings couldn't save their stocks
articles.description: All six banks fell following their earnings reports, even as some delivered strong results, reflecting concerns about interest rates and the economic outlook.

articles.title: Jim Cramer says don't give up on this unpredictable market. Here's why
articles.description: Despite an unpredictable market, CNBC's Jim Cramer says it's important to stay invested.

articles.title: Godfather of AI and 400 Scientists Want AI Models Cut Off From the Internet
articles.description: After a summer of AI models escaping test environments and hacking real companies, hundreds of researchers say the internet itself should be treated as a security boundary.

articles.title: Traders pile into 'bubble puts' on CoreWeave as neocloud stocks plunge
articles.description: As a key corner of the artificial intelligence trade takes a beating on Wednesday, traders are betting it could get even worse.

articles.title: Trump to appeal order blocking White House from banning MS NOW, CNN and Politico
articles.description: U.S. District Judge Timothy Kelly had ruled that the three outlets targeted by President Donald Trump can keep their access to the White House complex.

articles.title: OpenAI bugging suspect booked one-way ticket to Saudi Arabia with family before arrest
articles.description: "Like countless Americans, Mr. Alfozan came to this country years ago as a young person with a dream," his criminal defense lawyer said Wednesday.

articles.title: Developer Who Cloned Photoshop With AI Just Did the Same to Microsoft Office
articles.description: Developer Brandon Thomas used Anthropic's Claude to build free, open-source replicas of Word, Excel and PowerPoint. They're rough, but they show how cheap cloning software has become.

articles.title: OpenAI sued by 8 states over ChatGPT safety concerns
articles.description: OpenAI is facing mounting scrutiny over its safety and security practices, including around how the company is working to protect children.

articles.title: Organizations join forces to fight Illinois crypto tax, after 6-month pause
articles.description: Illinois officials already agreed to delay implementation of a 0.2% tax on crypto assets, but industry-aligned organizations are pushing for summary judgment on the merits.

articles.title: CoreWeave shares tumble as bond yields near 15% on concern about AI borrowing binge
articles.description: Shares of CoreWeave sank 15%, while yields in its bonds blew out further.

articles.title: Anduril employee tender offer would value the defense tech startup at $90 billion
articles.description: Anduril has been a major winner of the growing U.S. defense tech boom and President Donald Trump's plans to reindustrialize the U.S. military

articles.title: Morgan Stanley tops estimates as equities trading revenue beats expectations by $909 million
articles.description: Morgan Stanley topped expectations on the top and bottom lines for the third quarter.

articles.title: Bank of America shares drop after third-quarter revenue miss and regulatory penalty
articles.description: Bank of America shares fell Wednesday after the company posted weaker-than-expected trading revenue and the impact of a $1.2 billion Treasury fine.

articles.title: Dell stock plunges 11%, leading data center sell-off as fears mount about 'enterprise AI timing'
articles.description: Barclays downgraded Dell, HPE, and NetApp on concerns that enterprise AI adoption is lagging.

articles.title: AI Agents Made 138 Million Crypto Payments in a Year. Most Were Tiny
articles.description: A new Chainalysis report found payments through Coinbase’s x402 protocol surged from about 1,500 in mid-2025 to more than 138 million by Q3 2026, with U.S. wallets dominating spending on AI models.

articles.title: Bank of America hired 1,000 contractors to patch software flaws exposed by Anthropic's Mythos
articles.description: Bank of America hired 1,000 contractors to patch software flaws exposed by Anthropic’s Mythos, offering a rare look at costs involved in defending against AI.

articles.title: 10-year Treasury yield dips as traders look ahead to Thursday economic reports
articles.description: The 10-year Treasury note yield fell on Wednesday after climbing earlier in the day as traders awaited still more economic data Thursday.

articles.title: Bending Spoons skyrockets 41% as Berkshire Hathaway makes $330 million investment
articles.description: Berkshire's latest investment follows the $600 million it invested in the company's IPO this July.

articles.title: Russia's Biggest Bank Sberbank Wins Approval to Trade Bitcoin
articles.description: Sberbank now holds both custody and exchange status under Russia's new crypto law, and plans to bring Bitcoin, Ethereum and USDT to apps used by 110 million retail clients.

articles.title: Solana Sets a Date for Its Next Major Upgrade
articles.description: Solana's Alpenglow upgrade replaces the TowerBFT voting system on October 21, cutting finality from 12.8 seconds to a target of 150ms and pulling vote transactions out of blocks entirely.
